mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 75 degrees under overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School, with a waxing gibbous moon visible in the sky.

The City of Verona is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for students in grades K-12, with submissions open until July 22. Four winners will be selected to have their designs featured on stickers for the November election, with community voting scheduled from July 28 through August 7.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking further ahead, join us for trivia on July 28 at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly police report, on July 13, officers responded to a situation where a vehicle was found stuck on a large rock, resulting in the driver being arrested for an O-W-I.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful OREO Cookie Overload. The store is currently closed but will open its doors at 10:00 AM for you to enjoy your treat.
